description:
Settlements where this wallet is either the payer or the payee, newest first. Walkable deeply in time order: `(payer, block_time desc)` and `(payee, block_time desc)` cover it, so page N costs what page 1 does and a wallet's whole history can be paged for velocity or trend.

Wraps GET /v0/entities/{wallet}/settlements.
Access: requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer rh_live_… or x-api-key).

Returns:
- wallet: The wallet queried, lowercased.
- settlements: Settlement rows, newest first, decorated with resolved display names. Each row also carries `is_self_payment` (payer = payee, annotated rather than only excluded — a third of the feed can be self-payment) and `evidence`: `{ verified, method, probability, tier }`. `verified` is THREE-VALUED — `true` a named facilitator relayed it, `false` examined with no EIP-3009 marker, and `null` gasless and authorized but NOT ESTABLISHED as x402, which is not the same as disproven. `tier` is `proven` | `probable` | `unproven` | `not_x402` | `ungraded`.
- next_before: Cursor for the next page, or `null`.
- meta: The chain served and `as_of`. On a non-empty page `meta` also carries `page_self_payments`, `page_self_payment_usd`, `page_gross_usd` and `page_organic_usd`. All four are THIS PAGE only, as the names say: they are not site-wide figures and summing them across pages is not a total.

before.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_before`. It encodes the whole sort key, tiebreaker included, so a page boundary inside a group of rows sharing a timestamp does not skip the rest. Do not parse it or build one by hand.

limit.description: Rows to return. Clamped to 100; values outside the range are clamped, not rejected.

wallet.description: An EVM address (`0x` + 40 hex digits; case-insensitive, lowercased before lookup) or a Solana address (base58; case-sensitive, used exactly as given). An address the index has not observed answers `coverage.known: false`, not zeros.

name: list_entity_settlements
title: Settlements for one wallet
